title: MIRAGE-BENCH: Automatic Multilingual Benchmark Arena for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating RAG answer generation capabilities across 18 diverse languages to identify performance disparities between English and non-English queries, benchmarking proprietary and open-source models using heuristic features and an LLM-as-a-judge.

bias_targets.target: Evaluation bias (LLM-as-a-judge biases: Verbosity, Position, Self-enhancement)
bias_targets.methodology: Addressed during pairwise RAG arena evaluations by using fixed generation constraints to mitigate verbosity bias, randomly swapping model response positions to prevent position bias, and documenting potential self-enhancement bias when using GPT-4o as the judge model.
